summary: This study aims to investigate the metabolic changes in the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) in both healthy and diseased states using live imaging methods, focusing on the daily phagocytosis of photoreceptor outer segments and the adaptation of RPE mitochondria. The research will employ super-resolution high-speed live imaging, electron microscopy, and a perfused microphysiological organ-on-chip model to analyze the behaviors of RPE mitochondria and their interactions with actin and peroxisomes. The study will investigate three main questions related to RPE mitochondrial dynamics and lipid metabolism, and its findings will be compared with observations in human RPE cell lines and patient-derived iPSC-RPE cultures.
